fact: Yelen Assurance reported 25,000 producers insured under index insurance in 2023 after five years in Burkina Faso, with government premium subsidies, and noted that satellite rainfall data (ARC2) became inaccessible; a private insurer, not a government service.
title: L'assurance agricole indicielle au Burkina: retour d'expérience de Yelen Assurance et perspectives pour l'essor du secteur
